{{Top|leg}}
An '''eavesdropper''' was a [[Listening device/Legends|listening device]] used by the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]]. Disguised as part of [[Selby Jarrad]]'s gown, it was linked to an [[earsculpt]] that she wore. Jarrad deployed the eavesdropper to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Parco Ein]]'s office in the [[Verkuylian Imperial Governor's Hall]] during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] mission to liberate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="COI">{{JournalCite|13|Conflict of Interest}}</ref>
